sources.title: OAI System Liquid Cooling Guidelines
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 液冷 thermal ride-through：蓄熱量與反應時間
related.titleEn: Liquid-cooling thermal ride-through: stored heat and response time
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付平行圖、逐支路代回驗算、總量仍足夠但局部不足的反例與資料版本表；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the parallel graph, branch substitution checks, the sufficient-total-but-starved-branch counterexample and data-version table. Keep the modeled coefficients separate from measured equipment curves. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立 temperature、time、net_heat 與 capacitance 表，標記初始溫度和上限；不得把機房空氣與冷卻液溫度當同一狀態。
related.differenceEn: Build temperature, time, net heat and capacitance records, labeling the initial temperature and limit. Do not treat room air and coolant temperatures as one interchangeable state without a justified coupled model.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 各支路 q_i=sqrt(H/K_i)，總流量為各支路相加；此式假設固定共同壓差且互連歧管損失忽略；共同壓差 16 kPa；K1=1，K2 名義 4、變更 9，K 單位 kPa/(L/min)²；名義式 sqrt(16/1)+sqrt(16/4) = 6 L/min total；變更式 sqrt(16/1)+sqrt(16/9) = 5.33333333333 L/min total。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

固定淨熱功率下 C*dT/dt=P，達容許溫升 ΔT 的時間為 CΔT/P；C 需為熱容量，不是比熱；有效熱容量 500 kJ/K，容許升溫 8 K；淨熱量由 100 增為 200 kW，冷卻移除已從 P 扣除；名義式 500*8/100 = 40 s to modeled limit；變更式 500*8/200 = 20 s to modeled limit。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Each branch has q_i=sqrt(H/K_i), and total flow is their sum. Assume fixed common head and negligible manifold losses; do not add parallel resistances as if the branches were in series. Use common head 16 kPa, K1=1 and K2 changing from 4 to 9 in kPa/(L/min)². The primary branch remains unchanged while the second becomes more restrictive. Nominal sqrt(16/1)+sqrt(16/4) = 6 L/min total; changed sqrt(16/1)+sqrt(16/9) = 5.33333333333 L/min total. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Under constant net heat input, C*dT/dt=P, so time to allowed rise ΔT is CΔT/P. C is total thermal capacitance, not specific heat, and the model assumes a uniformly represented temperature. Set effective capacitance to 500 kJ/K and allowable temperature rise to 8 K. Net heat input changes from 100 to 200 kW, with any remaining heat removal already subtracted from P. Nominal 500*8/100 = 40 s to modeled limit; changed 500*8/200 = 20 s to modeled limit. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NAMD：複本交換的詳細平衡與隨機接受證據
related.titleEn: NAMD: replica-exchange detailed balance and acceptance evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付平行圖、逐支路代回驗算、總量仍足夠但局部不足的反例與資料版本表；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the parallel graph, branch substitution checks, the sufficient-total-but-starved-branch counterexample and data-version table. Keep the modeled coefficients separate from measured equipment curves. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「NAMD：複本交換的詳細平衡與隨機接受證據」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付權重推導、兩組接受事件、隨機種子與交換前後狀態對照表。
related.differenceEn: Investigate NAMD: replica-exchange detailed balance and acceptance evidence using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver the weight-ratio derivation, both acceptance events, random-stream identifiers and a before-and-after replica-state table that separates temperature labels from physical configurations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 各支路 q_i=sqrt(H/K_i)，總流量為各支路相加；此式假設固定共同壓差且互連歧管損失忽略；共同壓差 16 kPa；K1=1，K2 名義 4、變更 9，K 單位 kPa/(L/min)²；名義式 sqrt(16/1)+sqrt(16/4) = 6 L/min total；變更式 sqrt(16/1)+sqrt(16/9) = 5.33333333333 L/min total。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
計算 exp(−1)，在零到一的線上標記接受區間與 u=0.5；將機率與一次事件分開記錄。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Each branch has q_i=sqrt(H/K_i), and total flow is their sum. Assume fixed common head and negligible manifold losses; do not add parallel resistances as if the branches were in series. Use common head 16 kPa, K1=1 and K2 changing from 4 to 9 in kPa/(L/min)². The primary branch remains unchanged while the second becomes more restrictive. Nominal sqrt(16/1)+sqrt(16/4) = 6 L/min total; changed sqrt(16/1)+sqrt(16/9) = 5.33333333333 L/min total. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Calculate exp(-1), mark its acceptance interval on a unit line and place u=0.5 on the same line. Record the probability separately from the realized decision so that one event is not confused with an estimated rate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
